name: ArcChain / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A taut wet tendon rupture followed immediately by three fast climbing electric whip snaps over small watery spits. Very short chained electric-water detachment, no sustained hum.
